source_title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce earn praise for New York charity efforts
source_excerpt: In July, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce received a special message that put the spotlight on a meaningful part of their wedding celebrations. Before getting married, the couple reportedly donated $26 million to charitable organisations across the United States. Among the beneficiaries was New York Cares, which recently shared a touching Instagram post expressing its gratitude. The organisation's message was more than a simple thank-you. It recognised how the couple had used an important milestone in their relationship to support people facing difficult circumstances, turning their pre-wedding generosity into something that could make a lasting difference.New York Cares shares emotional message for Taylor Swift and Travis KelceThe organisation shared a purple-themed appreciation card addressed directly to the newlyweds. Its message included a sweet reference to Swift's music, making the acknowledgement particularly special for the singer's fans.âDear Taylor and Travis,Weâre Enchanted to receive your generous gift to support New Yorkers in need.Thank you for making our mission a part of your Love Story.Best wishes,new york cares.âAlongside the graphic, New York Cares explained how the contribution would help strengthen its work across New York City. The organisation highlighted its efforts to address food insecurity, provide winter clothing and support children through essential resources.Its achievements include more than 70 million meals served, over eight million volunteer hours, 2.7 million winter coats distributed, more than 720,000 Winter Wishes granted to children and over 70,000 backpacks provided to students.For those unfamiliar with the organisation, New York Cares is a nonprofit that connects volunteers with community programmes across New York City. Its work focuses on supporting underserved communities through food distribution, education, winter assistance and other essential services.The organisation also encouraged Swift's supporters to take part in its charitable efforts, writing, "And to the Swifties who want to celebrate with us, we'd love to start your Giving Era."Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's $26 million donation supports charitiesNew York Cares was among more than a dozen organisations that publicly acknowledged the couple's pre-wedding contribution. Their reported $26 million donation reached charities in several cities with personal connections to Swift and Kelce, including Reading, Pennsylvania, Cleveland, Nashville and Kansas City.The Grammy Museum Foundation also thanked the couple for their "transformative gift", explaining that the contribution would help expand music education opportunities for students across the country.Kansas City's Harvesters food bank shared its own message of appreciation, writing, âWeâd like to send a heartfelt thank you to @taylorswift and @killatrav for their very generous donation to our food bank just prior to their big wedding day. The two of them have incredibly big hearts and have shown up to support not only us but many charities over the years. We feel so lucky that they make the conscious effort to invest in hunger relief and the beautiful community we call Kansas City!âDolly Parton also joined the list of well-wishers, thanking Swift and Kelce for their $2 million donation to her Imagination Library, which provides free books to children.While the couple's wedding attracted plenty of attention, their decision to support charitable causes before getting married gave the celebrations another dimension.
